`enum BlendState.Equation`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BlendState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/BlendState.java)

The operation that combines the weighted source and destination colors of a blend state.

## Description

`S` is the color being drawn times its source factor, `D` the color on the target times its destination factor.
`MIN` and `MAX` ignore the factors.

## Learn more

- [Drawing resources and transforms](/use/learn/going-further/drawing-resources-and-transforms/#blend-with-what-is-under)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`ADD`](#BlendState-Equation-value-ADD) | `S + D`, the usual choice. |
| [`SUBTRACT`](#BlendState-Equation-value-SUBTRACT) | `S − D`, clamped at zero. |
| [`REVERSE_SUBTRACT`](#BlendState-Equation-value-REVERSE_SUBTRACT) | `D − S`, clamped at zero: darkens the target by what you draw. |
| [`MIN`](#BlendState-Equation-value-MIN) | The smaller of the source and the destination, channel by channel, without factors. |
| [`MAX`](#BlendState-Equation-value-MAX) | The larger of the source and the destination, channel by channel, without factors. |
